python3 - <<'PY'
from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_EVEN
import csv, io
pay='''record_id,regular_hours,overtime_hours,hourly_rate,deduction
EMP-001,159,7,31.19,202
EMP-002,145,6,27.4,165
EMP-003,158,7,42.76,168
EMP-004,130,9,23.1,138
EMP-005,144,4,23.06,173
EMP-006,148,9,40.39,174
EMP-007,154,10,32.54,138
EMP-008,150,2,36.51,231
EMP-009,156,8,45.9,191
EMP-010,143,6,32.84,207
'''
q=Decimal('.01'); ot=Decimal('1.73'); wh=Decimal('.2137')
s=Decimal(0); s2=Decimal(0)
for r in csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(pay)):
 reg=Decimal(r['regular_hours']); over=Decimal(r['overtime_hours']); rate=Decimal(r['hourly_rate']); ded=Decimal(r['deduction'])
 gross=reg*rate+over*rate*ot
 net=gross*(1-wh)-ded
 gross_r=gross.quantize(q, rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN)
 net_r=net.quantize(q, rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN)
 net2=(gross_r*(1-wh)-ded).quantize(q,rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN)
 s+=net_r;s2+=net2
 print(r['record_id'], gross, gross_r, net, net_r,net2)
print('totals direct',s,'rounded gross',s2)
PY

from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_EVEN
import csv, io
billing='''record_id,quantity,unit_price,shipping
CUS-001,28,63.66,74
CUS-002,40,55.6,62
CUS-003,72,30.9,24
CUS-004,16,11.51,53
CUS-005,34,64.0,43

CUS-007,37,65.85,19
CUS-008,66,36.68,62
CUS-009,40,15.6,44
CUS-010,53,22.76,34
'''
d=Decimal('0.0837'); t=Decimal('0.0673')
rows=list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(billing)))
tot=Decimal('0')
for r in rows:
 a=Decimal(r['quantity'])*Decimal(r['unit_price'])*(1-d)*(1+t)+Decimal(r['shipping'])
 q=a.quantize(Decimal('0.01'),rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN)
 print(r['record_id'], a, q)
 tot+=q
print(len(rows),tot)

python3 - <<'PY'
from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_EVEN
import csv, io
p='''record_id,quantity,unit_price,freight
SUP-001,164,56.53,781
SUP-002,324,137.19,441
SUP-003,168,99.98,799
SUP-004,217,83.66,454
SUP-005,363,124.67,189
SUP-006,233,17.23,154
SUP-007,64,57.17,700
SUP-008,373,134.81,599
SUP-009,61,82.1,154
SUP-010,266,93.01,518
'''
rate=Decimal('1.1379'); duty=Decimal('0.0427')
total=Decimal('0')
for r in csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(p)):
    amt=(Decimal(r['quantity'])*Decimal(r['unit_price'])+Decimal(r['freight']))*rate*(Decimal(1)+duty)
    rnd=amt.quantize(Decimal('.01'), rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN)
    print(r['record_id'], 'raw=', amt, 'rounded=', rnd)
    total+=rnd
print('count',10,'total',total)
PY
